groups.sentence: Instructors integrate AI into their courses and curricula, using field-relevant uses, to prepare students for AI use in future work.
Course statements tell students that learning AI is useful preparation for their future jobs and careers.
Instructors tell students at the start of the course that AI is a professional skill they will likely use in their careers.
Instructors help students develop critical thinking and ethical judgment about AI use to prepare for the workplace.
Instructors bring in industry guest speakers and real-world scenarios showing how AI is used in professions.
Students build an AI portfolio, and instructors keep evaluating and refining their teaching over time.
Employers and workplaces increasingly expect graduates to be able to use AI tools.
The university is preparing students for an AI-shaped workforce and future careers.
Students learn to use AI effectively and responsibly, since it will matter in their careers.
The university provides training, teaches responsible use, and integrates AI literacy into curricula so students are ready for work.
Employers value responsible, ethical AI use and judgment, not just technical skill.
Instructors may allow and encourage students to use AI as a tool.
